profile.headline: Software Developer at Epic - Care Everywhere
profile.summary: Honest and hardworking, dedicated, friendly and punctual. Experienced in group and individual communication and leadership. Over 5 years of work experience in various fields. Motivated with a strong desire to learn and have fun.

positions.title: Computer Science Instructor and Course Creator
positions.description:
Created a computer security course covering Password Salting, MAC, DHKE, and AES
Taught over 100 private computer science lessons ranging from basic data structures to complex algorithms to middle school and high school students over Zoom

positions.title: Front & Back End Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Guided university students in creating full-stack websites using Vue, Node, and MongoDB
Collaborated with other TAs to help over 200 different students every semester
Helped students debug dozens of unique full-stack creative projects

positions.title: Web Developer & Research Assistant
positions.description:
Added and connected 3 new Angular components to a backend and database
Maintained 2 former applications, Pedigree-Pie & Family Calendar
Implemented a continuous deployment environment using GitHub actions

positions.title: Door to Door Sales Representative
positions.description:
Achieved a contract retention rate of 96%, which was one of the highest in the company 
Generated over $100,000 of yearly recurring revenue for Greenix
